description.zh:
设定结果从marker之后按字母排序的第一个开始返回。如果不设定，则从头开始返回数据。
默认值：无
description.en:
Specifies that results are returned in alphabetical order starting from the first bucket after the marker value. If this parameter is not specified, results are returned from the beginning.
Default value: null.

description.zh:
限定此次返回Bucket的最大个数。
取值范围：1~1000
默认值：100
description.en:
Specifies the maximum number of buckets to return in this request.
Valid values: 1 to 1000.
Default value: 100.

description.zh:
限定返回的Bucket名称必须以prefix作为前缀。如果不设定，则不过滤前缀信息。
默认值：无
description.en:
Limits the returned bucket names to those that begin with the specified prefix. If this parameter is not specified, no prefix filtering is applied.
Default value: null.

description.zh: 指定Bucket标签键。列举结果中仅会包含那些打上了对应标签的Bucket。
description.en: Specifies the bucket tag key. Only buckets that have the specified tag are included in the results.

description.zh: 指定Bucket标签值。如果请求指定了该参数，那么必须同时指定tag-value，列举结果中仅会包含那些打上了对应标签键值对的Bucket。
description.en: Specifies the bucket tag value. If this parameter is specified, the tag-value parameter must also be specified. Only buckets that have the specified tag key-value pair are included in the results.

description.zh:
指定标签列表。如："k1":"v1","k2":"v2"，只有Bucket匹配列表中所有的标签键值对，才会出现在列举结果中。
tagging参数与tag-key和tag-value两个参数不能同时存在。
description.en:
Specifies a tag list, for example, "k1":"v1","k2":"v2". Only buckets that match all tag key-value pairs in the list are included in the results.
The tagging parameter cannot be used together with the tag-key and tag-value parameters.
The resource group ID to which the bucket belongs.

descriptions.zh:
- 您也可以通过设置prefix、marker或者max-keys参数列举满足指定条件的存储空间。
- 要列举存储空间，您必须有oss:GetService (ListBuckets)权限。具体操作，请参见[为RAM用户授权自定义的权限策略](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/199058.htm?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.48be7590hCA8LI#section-ucu-jv0-zip)。
- 调用接口时，如果所有Bucket已返回，则返回参数的XML中不包含Prefix、Marker、MaxKeys、IsTruncated和NextMarker响应元素。
descriptions.en:
- You can also use the prefix, marker, or max-keys parameter to list buckets that meet specified conditional criteria.
- To list buckets, you must have the oss:GetService (ListBuckets) authorization. For more information, see [Grant a custom access policy to a Resource Access Management (RAM) user](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/199058.htm?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.48be7590hCA8LI#section-ucu-jv0-zip).
- When you invoke this operation, if all buckets have been returned, the Prefix, Marker, MaxKeys, IsTruncated, and NextMarker response elements are not included in the XML body of the response.
